verdict.rationale: Penpot documents personal access tokens that let an app, and so an agent, authenticate against its API instead of a login. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped, permission-limited or restricted to specific resources, so only the basic credential part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: per-token scopes or permission levels, least-privilege restriction to specific teams/projects/files, agent-specific credential issuance, expiry/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
